description: This PHP source file defines the ProspectFormBase class, which provides methods for managing Prospect form rendering, duplicate checking, and saving in a SugarCRM/SuiteCRM environment. It includes functions for building form HTML, handling form submission, duplicate detection, and detailed form building.

classes.name: ProspectFormBase
classes.description: A class providing form rendering, duplicate checking, and saving functionalities for prospects within SugarCRM/SuiteCRM.

methods.name: checkForDuplicates
methods.description: Checks for duplicate prospects based on input fields such as name and email.

methods.name: buildTableForm
methods.description: Builds an HTML table form to display potential duplicate prospects for user selection.

methods.name: getWideFormBody
methods.description: Generates a comprehensive HTML form for prospect data entry, including address and contact details.

methods.name: getFormBody
methods.description: Creates a subset or simplified form layout for prospect data entry, suitable for quick edits or email contexts.

methods.name: getForm
methods.description: Generates the complete HTML form for creating or editing prospects, including form headers and footer.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Processes form submission, handling validation, duplicate checking, saving the record, and redirecting or returning the prospect bean.
